Software Engineer, Robotics Platform

London, United Kingdom

Acme Robotics builds warehouse robots that help small businesses ship orders faster. As a Software Engineer on the Robotics Platform team you will design and build the route planning and fleet coordination services that keep robots moving safely. You will work in Python and TypeScript.
